description: This file defines an abstract test case class 'SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase' for the SuiteCRM project. It extends a base test case and provides setup and teardown methods to initialize and restore environment variables, database connections, and logging used in suite testing. The class uses external components like BeanFactory, DBManagerFactory, and LoggerManager to manage dependencies.

classes.name: SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase
classes.description: An abstract class for SuiteCRM PHPUnit testing framework, managing environment setup and cleanup.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Class-level setup, initializes DB connection, disconnects and checks connection.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Instance setup before each test, initializes global variables, logging, DB instances, and environment variables.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores environment variables, global state, and database instances after each test.
